frequency_question: How often do major nationwide bank employee federations execute an indefinite strike after issuing a formal strike notice or call within the designated window?
membership_rule: Includes instances where nationwide bank union coalitions formally called for strikes or industrial action; excludes localized or single-bank strikes not involving the overarching coalition.
window: Within 30 to 90 days of the call or notice
coverage_note: 5 named major call cycles; captures the principal actors' demonstrated follow-through rate.
known_gaps: Some minor one-day warning strikes are excluded to focus on indefinite or multi-day major strike escalations.
skeleton: Total recorded nationwide strike execution attempts by the coalition divided by total formal strike calls issued under similar bargaining impasses over a 10-year baseline.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 documented major coalition calls
validity_reason: Labor union leadership dynamics and bargaining structures in this sector evolve slowly over multi-year periods.
